{{Quote|I don't see the point. There is no love left in the world. Oh, there are brief glimpses, but those soon fade or are crushed beneath the boots of war and strife.|Benjamin|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Benjamin''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who lived on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He at one point participated in the [[Festival of Love]].
